rows.text: In post hoc analyses: at 3 LT, while the posterior-mean forecast still has anomaly correlation 0.93 with the truth, the sign of a small intervention's effect is confident for 37% of questions about the seven patterns whose sign climatology never gives, against 67% for the forecast sign (99% interval for the difference [−0.42, −0.18]); the loss tracks disagreement among posterior draws about the intervention's effect on the mean flow rather than its direct energy injection; the ordering holds for the energy of a 10-site block; and a deterministic CNN emulator given the posterior's own histories is confident about as often as the posterior, but its observation-dependent confident answers are right 93.7% of the time against 99.5%.
